# Amer Hamdan

> Senior Full-Stack Engineer · Tech Lead · AI-Product Development. Based in Istanbul, Türkiye. Open to senior full-stack, tech lead, and AI-product roles — remote or Istanbul.

Senior full-stack engineer and team lead with ten years building and rebuilding production web platforms across news, recruitment, healthcare research, and SaaS. Leads small teams through legacy migrations — PHP to Laravel, WordPress to Next.js — and ships the result with measurable gains in performance, engagement, and delivery rate. Comfortable owning the whole path: data model, API, interface, cloud deployment, and the SEO and Core Web Vitals work that decides whether anyone finds the product at all.
